description: Turn anything into study tools with AI Cramberry helps students turn notes, PDFs, slides, videos, and more into flashcards, quizzes, summaries, and even audio lessons — instantly. No more rewriting notes or wasting hours studying passively. What you can do - Upload notes, PDFs, slides, images, audio, or YouTube videos - Generate flashcards with spaced repetition - Create practice quizzes and tests - Get clean summaries from messy content - Ask an AI tutor questions based on your material - Conve
